topic: Floating post office Dal Lake Srinagar
hook: Your Srinagar letter can be posted from a houseboat.
title: India's Post Office That Floats on a Lake
description:
On Dal Lake in Srinagar, there's a post office housed on a houseboat. You can post letters and postcards from the water. It's India's floating post office. Part of the series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Srinagar #DalLake
